title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Booking a Charge for Instalments Left Unpaid
content:
## Credit control desk entry

Where instalments on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record have been left unpaid past their due day, the agreement earns a charge for them, and that charge is booked against the agreement by the desk. The charge is attached to the invoice the owner was already billed on, is stamped with the current billing month, and raises the amount the owner owes under the agreement by the amount booked.

### How the charge is booked

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `charge_late_fee_06bbd225` and calls it. One call books a single charge of that kind against the named agreement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record the charge is booked against | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `invoice_ref` | the invoice number the charge is attached to, copied from the instalment entry it belongs to in the agreement's history; the office raises no new invoice number for this charge | `INV-` followed by 8 digits |
| `fee_amount_usd` | the money amount booked | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and books a zero charge |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the charge entry created, the agreement it was booked against, the invoice it was attached to and the amount booked in USD to two decimal places. That line is issued only when the charge has been written and the agreement's outstanding balance has been raised; it is the receipt of completion.

### Observable effect

Afterwards the charge appears in the agreement's history and the agreement's outstanding balance is higher by exactly the amount booked.
